dialogues.speaker: Fangju
dialogues.text: Welcome to Hezhe Post. This is where the Communications Office conducts its business at Yilong Wharf. What can I do for you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do you guys do here?

dialogues.speaker: Fangju
dialogues.text: The registration of people and goods entering and exiting, the inspection and, if needed, the quarantine of the above, applications for delivery within Liyue's borders, and ad-hoc goods storage — those are our four main tasks.

dialogues.speaker: Fangju
dialogues.text: Usually, outlanders who wish to do business in Liyue and who arrive at Yilong Wharf will come here to register their personal information.

dialogues.speaker: Fangju
dialogues.text: Our staff will then inspect and disinfect their goods.

dialogues.speaker: Fangju
dialogues.text: If you wish to transport goods to other locations within Liyue's borders, this is where you register.

dialogues.speaker: Fangju
dialogues.text: We will also evaluate the total quantity of goods and distances to destinations, and the manifests will be sent to transport units or our partners at the Secure Transport Agency, after which said secondary departments will do the actual transportation.

dialogues.speaker: Fangju
dialogues.text: If you have not yet planned a final delivery destination, you can also register here to have them stored temporarily in one of our warehouses.

dialogues.speaker: Fangju
dialogues.text: Of course, all this assumes you already have a formal business permit. If you need one, we can also serve as a proxy to help you apply for it.

dialogues.speaker: Fangju
dialogues.text: Of course, that would be a bit less efficient than doing it in Liyue Harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The Communications Office?

dialogues.speaker: Fangju
dialogues.text: If you want to better understand our duties, it might be best to consult the Ministry of Civil Affairs. I am just a lowly staff member, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Fangju
dialogues.text: To the best of my knowledge, our office is mainly responsible for transportation in Liyue. We are also involved, where appropriate, with related construction and road management, which is why we have a rather large number of staff.

dialogues.speaker: Fangju
dialogues.text: Good road networks, bridges, waterways, and docks are critical to transporting goods to various locations in Liyue, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Fangju
dialogues.text: Regardless of whether you're interested in traveling with a caravan, or have some talent in architecture, you're welcome to consider becoming an employee.

dialogues.speaker: Fangju
dialogues.text: And like me, enjoy the nice stable, peaceful life of an employee here in the office. It's not bad.

dialogues.speaker: Fangju
dialogues.text: Of course, the Office also conducts monthly performance evaluations to discourage negligence...

dialogues.speaker: Fangju
dialogues.text: So if you want to keep working here, you'll have to constantly improve yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't have any questions for you at the moment...

dialogues.speaker: Fangju
dialogues.text: Well, you might become a world-walking merchant for all we know — you'll have things to ask of us then, I'd expect.
